q: From November 1, 2026, through January 31, 2027, attacks halt flows through Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline or crude loadings at the port of Yanbu for at least seven consecutive days, or attacks cut daily merchant transits of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait below 10 ships for seven consecutive days
basis: The Houthis, who declared a maritime blockade of Saudi Arabia on July 22, have since attacked Saudi tankers and energy facilities. Strikes on pipeline pumping stations stopped flows for 11 days, September 11–22. With the Strait of Hormuz closed, Saudi crude exports are concentrated at Yanbu, so losing this bypass would cause Gulf crude exports to collapse.
rs: Announcements by Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry and Aramco, and ship-tracking counts from Windward and in Reuters reports
